svg.desc: Вывод строки TEXT бинарного сигнала для информац. окон

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub HighlightMessage() If pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD Then msg_txt.text_decoration = "password" msg_txt.fill = 0xa0a0a0 msg_txt.font_size = 11 msg_txt.font_weight = "normal" Else msg_txt.text_decoration = "none" If pv.Value != 0 Then msg_txt.fill = 0 msg_txt.font_size = 13 msg_txt.font_weight = "bold" Else msg_txt.fill = 0xa0a0a0 msg_txt.font_size = 11 msg_txt.font_weight = "normal" End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If PvNumber > 0 Then pv = BIN(PvNumber) If !IsNull(pv) Then pv_exists = True msg_txt.text = PLStrCut(pv.PVText, 24) msg_txt.title = pv.PVDescription Else msg_txt.text = "-" End If Else msg_txt.text = "" End If
